text: 🚨 President Trump admits the US deportation policy was "too tough" following the Republicans' rout in the midterms.
🚨 Iran's Foreign Ministry says the International Atomic Energy Agency carried out an inspection at the Bushehr nuclear power plant several days ago.

A French Foreign Ministry report claims Israeli officials, media and influencers pushed the idea that France's protests stem from immigration and radical Islam.

From Oct 16 to 18, Israeli linked posts drew 35 million views, MAGA linked ones 49 million.

🚨 Iran will judge the new US leadership only by its actions on the ground, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Baghaei says.

He calls the US vote a protest against warmongering and says the "Iron Gate" task force aims to deflect from the midterms.

🚨 Iran will capture or shoot down "aggressor drones" depending on conditions, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Baghaei says.

He blames insecurity in the Strait of Hormuz on US and Israeli actions and says all passing ships must coordinate with Iran.
🚨 Gadi Eisenkot says Benjamin Netanyahu and his allies are welcome to join a new Israeli government, but only under his leadership and on his terms.

🚨 More ships appear to be on fire in the Strait of Hormuz.

New footage filmed from a small boat near the coast shows a thick plume of black smoke rising over the waterway.

At least 25 seafarers have been killed since the war on Iran began on 28 February, International Maritime Organization figures show, with Indian sailors hit hardest at 16 dead.

The IMO counts at least 129 attacks on shipping in and around Hormuz.

Norway's Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre says Europe should talk to Moscow directly, warning that "the only voice reaching Moscow comes from Washington."

He doubts Putin truly wants peace and expects no breakthrough at the Abu Dhabi talks this week.

Senior Emirati official Anwar Gargash warns the region could face a long stretch of uncertainty.

He says a comprehensive political settlement between Washington and Tehran to end the war, now in its ninth month, looks difficult to reach.

🚨 Thermal satellite imagery appears to show three ships burning in the Strait of Hormuz since this morning.

The new hotspots follow earlier footage of a non compliant vessel on fire in the strait.

🚨 President Trump told 60 Minutes he does not disagree with JD Vance that the Iran war cost Republicans the midterms.

Would he do it again? "An emphatic yes, because you can't let Iran have a nuclear weapon."
🚨 A US Air Force HC 130J Combat King II (12 5768) is squawking 7700, the general emergency code, over the Persian Gulf after taking off from a US base in Kuwait.
President Trump says the countries America has protected will repay all the costs, because without the United States they would not exist.

🚨 Early warning sirens sounded across Riyadh at 9:15 AM local time after missile launches from Yemen, disrupting the city's airspace.

Saudi Civil Defense has since declared the danger over.

Bilal Erdogan, son of Turkey's president, is expected in Lebanon within days.

He is set to meet senior government officials in Beirut and local figures in Tripoli, the Sunni stronghold in the north, Kan News reports.

President Trump to a reporter on Iran: "If Iran has a nuclear weapon, there would be no Israel, no Middle East."

He said America had just saved them, and defended Pete Hegseth, telling Fox News the Defense Secretary is "only guilty of winning two wars."

🚨 A missile launch has been reported from Yemen.

A photo taken from the area shows a fresh launch trail climbing into the sky.

Myanmar resistance fighters raid a junta camp and seize the army's newest rifles.

Joint anti junta forces stormed a Burmese Army and militia camp in Maw Luu, Sagaing Region, capturing several MA 1 MK II T1 assault rifles, the latest MA series variant.
🚨 Footage shows a vessel on fire in the Strait of Hormuz, reported to be a non compliant ship.
